## Où j'en suis
The QPAY-2291 work: the pre-upload NACHA validator is done and #1475 is merged; the ACK watchdog is written, tested and open as quillon/core#1481 on `tomer/ack-watchdog`, based on `tomer/nacha-validator`. The last instruction was to move on to the postmortem doc for Friday's review. (source: ses-ach-3, v3-13, ses-ach-2)

- [en-cours] PR quillon/core#1481 is open; it needs a rebase onto main now that #1475 has merged (source: v3-12, ses-ach-3)
- [en-cours] Postmortem doc, not yet started; the review is Fri 20 Nov 16:00 TLV and Tomer presents (source: v3-13, src-slack-avi)
- [prochaine-étape] Rebase #1481, then write the postmortem; Carla needs the written version by Mon 23 Nov (source: v3-12, src-jira-2291)
- [prochaine-étape] PagerDuty routing for the payouts service (terraform, Elad) — without it the page reaches nobody (source: v3-12, src-jira-2291)
- [essai-raté] The watchdog's first deadline test failed: `cutoff.rs` used a fixed UTC-5 offset, so after DST it computed a deadline before the upload ran; switched to `chrono_tz::America::Chicago` (source: v3-04, v3-06)
- [essai-raté] The validator's first version passed the rejected 10 Nov file because it measured trimmed record lengths (source: v2-06)
- [question] The Corvane SFTP password appeared in the transcript; rotation with Elad was planned for today — status unknown (source: v3-09)
- [décision] The validator fails closed: block the upload and page, never silently modify a bank file (source: v2-03, src-slack-avi)
- [décision] Runbooks list env var names and Vault paths only, never values (source: v3-09)
